summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K attaching a July 30, 2026 press release reporting Q2 2026 results, including 17.8% CER sales growth and business EPS of €2.09, along with an upgraded FY2026 guidance of ~10% CER sales growth. The release also noted strategic pipeline decisions, discontinuation of certain programs, completion of a €1 billion buyback, and CEO commentary on transformation. This is routine quarterly reporting and guidance, not a special-situation event.
